normalized.description: Following the endorsement of the ESA Ecodesign Policy in October 2025, the systematic integration of ecodesign principles into ESA programmes and projects has become a key enabler for achieving ESA Green Agenda objectives. However, current Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) approaches remain too complex and resource-intensive for routine use during mission conception and preliminary design. This activity addresses this gap through the development of a simplified LCA and ecodesign tool for space missions, enabling rapid environmental assessments and the comparison of alternative design solutions during phases A/B1. The tool developed in this activity will provide a practical and harmonised means to support ecodesign implementation across the European space sector while ensuring consistency with ESA environmental datasets and European assessment methodologies. The project targets bringing the technology to TRL 6.
